title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：success　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 success 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the foreman ① won the success that no worker in the site would have measured, and he said the winning was the whole of the shift. The ② success, meaning the achievement itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed unmeasured in the book; success, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of success in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ success at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Success, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the foreman said the measuring is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the success was the whole of the matter, meaning the pride and not the achievement. The ⑥ success, meaning the pride and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; success, he said, is either something you win or the only word that means both achievement and a pride. He said the pride is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ success had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ success of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of measuring; success, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ success I remember is the success measured in the sheet, which closed in 1962 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. ⑩ Success, my mother said in 1964, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all success, she said, is a pride that has agreed to look like achievement. She said the pride was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 成功（指工地里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 成功（指那次成功本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：win the success 取得这一次成功
D. n. 成功（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 成功之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的成功之事）
F. n. 成功（指施工单里写到、被测量的那一次）
G. n. 成功、荣光（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 荣光（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: won the success that no worker in the site would have measured
The success, meaning the achievement itself and not the rope
Every sort of success in that site
the success at the far ramp
the success was the whole of the matter
the success had become a line in a sheet
The success of the whole thing

answers.why: win the success 意为“取得这一次成功”，1955 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯测量的一次成功做了一遍。
success 意为“成功”，指那次成功本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。
success 意为“成功”，指工地里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
success 意为“成功”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
success 意为“成功、荣光”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次荣光就是那件事的全部。
success 意为“荣光”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次成功，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
success 意为“成功”，指施工单里写到、被测量的那一次，到 1960 年这一次成了施工单里的一行。
success 意为“成功之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的成功之事是一处工地和三个班次的测量。
success 意为“成功”，我记得的是施工单里测量过的那一次，1962 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一次。
success 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，成功是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的成功。
